name: Worker
text: Our village is going to be flooded! Can you help us build a canal to divert the water?

name: Player
text: Of course! What do we need to get started?

name: Worker
text: We'll need some materials before we can begin construction.

name: Worker
text: Gather 5 Metal, 10 Wood, and 8 Stone to reinforce the canal walls.

name: Player
text: Got it! I’ll collect the materials and meet you by the riverbank.

name: Worker
text: Hurry! The floodwaters are rising fast!

name: System
text: Objective Updated: Collect 5 Metal, 10 Wood, and 8 Stone to start building the canal.
